interpretation.normal: prerequisites for individual pickups/stage clear; alternatives encoded as OR-of-ANDs
interpretation.movement: extra movement prerequisites only when movement_unlocks on; blank means not documented, not proven unnecessary
interpretation.available: informational ONLY, never an unconditional prerequisite
interpretation.advanced_routes: recorded for review, disabled for standard logic
interpretation.all_required_wisps: terminal boss special case, depends on boost_lock and movement_unlocks
interpretation.wisp_names: abstract abilities; Codex resolves normal/progressive item names per YAML
interpretation.boost: when boost_lock false, boost prerequisite is automatically satisfied
interpretation.unknown: unknown or ambiguous entries must be manually reviewed, not interpreted as empty routes
interpretation.ranks: score/time are metadata; ranks are checked by actual game result, not simulated from items
